fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) and Tesla (TSLA) face concerns that Democratic victory will strengthen AI data center construction regulations, with TSLA declining 4%, and 800–1,000 planned AI data center construction projects expected to face delays over the next two years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Democratic governor-elect in Texas with anti-data center orientation identified as key risk factor, as Texas accounts for 25–30% of U.S. data center capacity and AI infrastructure buildout.
